content: Allar wadar suktir sinno
Ibraimor boyoš zehon nobboi no bosor oiye, hẽtte Mabude hibare deha diye edde hodde, "Ãi he Šorbo-Šoktiwala Allah, ãr issa mozin sol edde hosuri sara o.
Ar ãi tui edde ãr maze ãr wadar sukti buwaiyum edde tor bongšore beši baraidiyum."
Henot Ibraime soida foijje, toi Allaye hibare hodde,
"Sa, iyan ãr wadar sukti tor loi: Tui bout zatir baf oibi.
Tore ar Ibraim hoi ḍaka no oibo, kintu tor nam oibo Ibrahim, kiyollahoile ãi tore bout zatir baf goijji.
Ãi tore fólwala goriyum, ar tor butottu bout zati goriyum, edde tor butottu badša okkol niyoli aibo.
Ãi tui edde ãr maze azibonor wadar sukti buwaiyum, ze wadar sukti tui edde tor bongšor bade bongšo dori sirohal solat takibo. Ãi tor edde tor bongšor manuš okkolor Allah oiyum.
Ze Kenan dešot tui ehon bidešitta oi zibon haṛaor, hiyanore ãi tui edde tor bongšore sirohalolla šombotti hisabe diyum, edde hitarar Allah oiyum."
Toi Allaye Ibrahimore hodde, "Tottu o ãr wadar sukti falon gora foribo, tui bade tor bongšodor okkole o.
Iyan oilde ãr wadar sukti ziyan tui edde ãre maze, tui bade tor bongšodor okkolor maze: Tũwarar fotti furušore azomi gora foribo.
Tũwara fottizonor bodar baror sam haṛa foribo, ar iyan oibode ãr edde tũwarar maze wadar suktir sinno.
Bongšor bade bongšo dori tũwarar furuš fuwain okkol zormo oi ašṭo dinor din azomi gora foribo, enki zara bongšodor no, kintu tor górot zormo oiye ba hono bidešittattu kinna gulam okkolore udda.
Tor górot zormo oiye ba tor kinna gulam, hitarare o azomi gora foribo. Ar iyan oilde tũwarar gat sirohalolla ãr wadar sukti asede sinno.
Kintu ze hono azomi agoraiya, zarare bodar sam haṛa no o, hitare hitar nizor zatir butottu fũsifela oibo, kiyollahoile hite ãr wadar sukti bainge."
Allaye Ibrahimore aro hodde, "Tor bou Saraire tui Sarai name no ḍakis; hibar nam oibo Sarah.
Ãi hibare duwa goriyum, ar hibattu o ãi tore ek fut diyum. Ãi hibare duwa goriyum toi hiba bout zati okkolor ma oibo; Hibar butottu badša okkol aibo."
Hetunot Ibrahime uite fori hãšše edde mone mone hodde, "Ek šot bosor oiyede ekzonottu ki fut zormo oibo? Ar nobboi bosojja Saraye ki fuwa biyaibo?"
Bade Ibrahime Allare hodde, "Ismail tũwar rahamote basi takok!"

Toi Allaye hodde, "Tor bou Saraye hameka tolla ek morod fuwa biyaibo, ar tui hitar nam Isak rakibi. Ãi hitar loi ãr wadar sukti buwaiyum, ek sirohalolla zari takibode wadar sukti, hite bade hitar bongšo okkololla.

Ar Ismailor babute tor foriyad ãi funni: Sa, ãi hitare o duwa goriyum, ar hitare fólwala goijjum edde hitar bongšo beši baraidiyum. Hitar butottu baro sordar okkol uṛibo, ar ãi hitare ek ḍõr zati banaiyum.
Agami bosor en šomot Saraye tolla zare biyaibo, he Isak loi kintu ãi ãr wadar sukti buwaiyum."
Ibrahim loi hota howa šeš gori bade Allah hibar hentu uṛi giyegoi.
Allaye hoilde mozin, he ekkui dinot Ibrahime hibar fut Ismailore edde hibar górot zormo oiyede edde hibar kinna gulam, hitara beggunore, hibar góror hár furuš okkolore loi azomi goraiye.
Ibrahimor boyoš nobboi no bosor zẽtte hibare azomi gora oiye,
ar hibar fut Ismailor boyoš tero;
Ibrahim edde Ismail dunizonore ekkui dinot azomi gora oiye.
Ar hibar fũwati Ibrahimor góror hár furuš okkol, górot zormo oiyede edde bidešittattu kinna gulam, hitara beggunore azomi gora oiye.
